subject.title: refactor: separate external conversations from local sessions

question: Should OpenClaw permanently adopt the new `conversations_*` tool/Gateway contract and fold its conversation-delivery tables and required target column into the unshipped agent-database v11 schema?
rationale: This choice creates public agent, protocol, native-client, Plugin SDK, and persisted-data contracts; correctness tests cannot determine whether maintainers want that permanent product and upgrade surface.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept the proposed contract after redacted two-peer Reef, cancellation, restart-recovery, and real pre-v11 upgrade evidence is attached and reviewed.

options.title: Split the contract
options.body: Land conversation identity and migration separately from correlated turns and durable delivery so each permanent boundary can be reviewed and proven independently.

options.title: Defer the new surface
options.body: Keep sessions plus explicit message targets as the supported interfaces until a narrower conversation API and migration design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed contract after redacted two-peer Reef, cancellation, restart-recovery, and real pre-v11 upgrade evidence is attached and reviewed.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the paired product issue and has prior merged history on session, transcript, and sessions_send behavior central to the decision.
